query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over names, paths, kinds, values, method names and field names. Each result lists its matches, such as name or field:Stamina. Empty or absent returns every entry.

results.description: Dump metadata records, each with a source path and an evidence record.

skipped.description: Dump files that were not valid JSON and so contributed nothing.

operations.title: Detect a game
operations.summary: Identify a game's engine, version, runtime, loader and paths without writing into the game folder.

operations.title: List game installs
operations.summary: List game folders under GMF_GAME_ROOTS and the workspace game path; Steam libraries are included when no root is configured or includeSteam is true.

operations.title: Engine family hints
operations.summary: Report engine family markers (Godot, GameMaker, Source, Ren'Py, RPG Maker, CryEngine, Frostbite, Construct, Unity WebGL) found in a game folder.

operations.title: Identify a game
operations.summary: Hash the game executable and read the product, company and store identity hints.

operations.title: Inventory a game install
operations.summary: List the files and folders of a game install with sizes and counts, without reading file content.

operations.title: Profile a game
operations.summary: Detect the engine, read identity, runtime, loader and paths, assemble a profile with evidence and unknowns, and write it into the workspace.

operations.title: Back up a game file
operations.summary: Copy a game file into the workspace backups folder and record its SHA-256 before a game write.

operations.title: Hash a file
operations.summary: Return the SHA-256 and size of a file so a deployed or packaged artifact can be compared with its build output.

operations.title: Restore a backed-up game file
operations.summary: Restore a game file from a recorded backup after verifying the backup hash. Writing into the game folder is a soft-gated gameWrite.

operations.title: Run a registered tool
operations.summary: Run a registered tool with explicit arguments under the owned-process layer and return the exit code and the log tail. Use it to reproduce a failing command exactly.

operations.title: Search the knowledge base
operations.summary: Search knowledge notes by ID, title, tags and body text; returns metadata, confidence and the path, not the body.

operations.title: Show a knowledge note
operations.summary: Return one knowledge note's metadata and full text by id. Find ids with knowledge.search.

id.description: A note id such as unity.asset-tools.

operations.title: Apply a plan
operations.summary: Run the steps in order. Each step's effects are authorized individually; a step without an authorization stops the plan unless it is optional.

operations.title: Draft a plan
operations.summary: Turn a goal and a profile into a draft plan with effects, gates, missing tools and risks. It never executes a step.

operations.title: Validate a plan
operations.summary: Check operation IDs, required inputs, tool requirements, effect coverage and gates; report every problem, not only the first.

operations.title: List skills
operations.summary: List every gmf skill with its summary, the operations it routes to and the knowledge it loads.

operations.title: Show a skill
operations.summary: Return one skill's full text: the steps, evidence and pitfalls for a kind of modding job. Hosts without plugin skills read skills this way.

name.description: A skill name such as unity-assets.

operations.title: Install a registered tool
operations.summary: Download and verify a registered tool into the tool cache. Needs a toolInstall authorization from the plan or the user's instruction.

operations.title: List registered tools
operations.summary: List every registered tool with its purpose, license, install state and resolved path.

operations.title: Verify an installed tool
operations.summary: Check that a registered tool resolves to an existing path and, when the registry publishes one, matches its size or SHA-256.

operations.title: Build a Unity mod
operations.summary: Run dotnet build on a scaffolded Unity mod project and return the exact command, exit code and output.

operations.title: Decompile Unity assemblies
operations.summary: Decompile Mono managed assemblies with ilspycmd, or an IL2CPP game with Cpp2IL or Il2CppDumper, into the workspace decompiled folder.

normalize.description: Write dumps/unity-<backend>.json for the analyze operations. Default true.

format.description: IL2CPP only: the Cpp2IL output format, diffable-cs (default, normalizable C#) or dummydll for assemblies.

operations.title: Deploy a Unity mod
operations.summary: Copy a built mod assembly into the installed loader's plugin folder, backing up every overwritten file first.

operations.title: Extract Unity assets
operations.summary: Export Unity assets (textures, sprites, audio, text, MonoBehaviours, meshes, fonts, shaders) with AssetStudioModCLI into the workspace extracted folder. Reads the game only.

assetPath.description: A .assets or bundle file or a folder, relative to the game folder. Default: the data folder.

types.description: AssetStudio asset types, comma-separated: tex2d, sprite, textAsset, monoBehaviour, font, shader, audio, video, mesh, or all (default).

filter.description: Only assets whose name matches (AssetStudio --filter-by-name; comma-separated).

mode.description: export (default), exportRaw, dump, jsonDump or info.

operations.title: Inspect a Unity asset
operations.summary: Read object metadata from a Unity asset file with UnityPy and write the metadata into the workspace.

operations.title: Normalize a Unity decompile or dump
operations.summary: Build the normalized dump JSON the analyze operations read from a decompiled C# tree or a Cpp2IL text dump. Keeps names and members only; no method bodies.

operations.title: Package a Unity mod
operations.summary: Build a local Thunderstore-style zip with the mod assembly, manifest and README.

operations.title: Remove a deployed Unity mod
operations.summary: Back up every file of a deployed BepInEx plugin or MelonLoader mod into the workspace, then remove it from the game. Needs a gameWrite authorization.

name.description: The plugin folder under BepInEx/plugins, or the assembly name under Mods, without .dll.

operations.title: Replace a Unity asset
operations.summary: Replace one object in a Unity asset file: UnityPy writes the changed file into the workspace, then gmf backs up the game file and copies the new one in. Textures take an image, TextAssets any file, other types a JSON object of type-tree fields.

assetPath.description: The .assets or bundle file, relative to the game folder.

object.description: The object's path id or name, from unity.inspect_asset.

replacementPath.description: The new content: an image, a file, or a .json object of type-tree fields.

operations.title: Scaffold a Unity mod
operations.summary: Render a BepInEx 5, BepInEx 6 Mono, BepInEx 6 IL2CPP or MelonLoader mod project into the workspace mods folder.

operations.title: Install a Unity mod loader
operations.summary: Download a registered Unity mod loader (BepInEx 6 bleeding edge for IL2CPP) and copy it next to the game executable, backing up every file it overwrites. Needs toolInstall and gameWrite authorizations.

loader.description: bepinex6-il2cpp. Default: the loader for the detected backend.

operations.title: Validate a Unity mod
operations.summary: Check that every Harmony patch in the mod source names a type and method that exists in the game's assemblies.

operations.title: Emit a wildcarded signature
operations.summary: Build a byte pattern from the instructions at a file offset, wildcard RIP-relative displacements, count its matches in the executable and resolve the first RIP-relative target. A pattern that does not match exactly once is an error with the count.

offset.description: File offset of the function start.

maxBytes.description: Pattern length limit in bytes. Default 32.

operations.title: Verify a signature
operations.summary: Count the matches of a byte pattern (with ?? and ? wildcards) in the executable and list their file offsets.

operations.title: Build an Unreal mod
operations.summary: Build a UE4SS C++ mod with xmake and return the exact command, exit code and log tail. Lua and pak mods return a no-op build result.

operations.title: Build the game docs from a dump run
operations.summary: Write Markdown docs for a collected GmfDumper run into gamedocs/ inside the workspace: classes, structs, enums, data, Blueprint scripts, class defaults, levels, assets, and the settings, localization and plugin pages when unreal.read_containers was run. Start reading at gamedocs/overview.md. An existing folder is replaced only when it is an earlier docs build; a failed build keeps the previous docs. Sections without input are listed in README.md and in missing.

run.description: Run folder name under dumps/unreal/runs, or an absolute path. Default: the newest run by name.

outputDir.description: Folder inside the workspace. Default: gamedocs.

gameExe.description: The game executable the console variable names are read from. Default: the run's game_exe, then the profile's executable.

prune.description: After a build with no missing section, from a run that passes unreal.verify_dump, remove the run files the docs distilled (tool inputs such as usmap, jmap, headers, Lua types, SDK and the object dump stay). Default true.

operations.title: Read a UE4SS crash stack
operations.summary: Parse a crash log or cdb stack text into frames, the faulting module and the nearest mod file.

operations.title: Deploy an Unreal mod
operations.summary: Copy a UE4SS Lua mod to the Mods folder, a C++ mod DLL to Mods/<name>/dlls, or a pak mod to Content/Paks/LogicMods. Every overwritten file is backed up first.

operations.title: Deploy the GmfDumper UE4SS helper
operations.summary: Copy the GmfDumper Lua mod and its default config into the UE4SS Mods folder and merge the dumper keys into UE4SS-settings.ini. With a toolInstall authorization it also downloads the native part (dlls/main.dll) and installs it only when it was built for the installed UE4SS build; native reports installed, mismatch, unknown, unavailable or not_authorized, and an older dll that is not replaced is removed. Every overwritten or removed file is backed up first.

operations.title: Dump Unreal objects, usmap and headers
operations.summary: Prepare the UE4SS dump layout in the workspace, detect existing object, usmap and header dumps, and return the exact console commands or settings for the missing ones. collect copies the newest complete GmfDumper run into dumps/unreal/runs/<run>/ and the loose UE4SS dumps into dumps/, then normalizes the object dump to dumps/unreal-objects.json unless normalize is false. With deployHelper set it also writes the GmfDumper mod into the game folder and installs its native part when that matches the installed UE4SS (reported under helper.native); it then needs a gameWrite authorization, and the native part needs toolInstall. Both gates are checked in the handler because the effect depends on the input.

normalize.description: When an object dump is found, write dumps/unreal-objects.json for the analyze operations. Default true.

deployHelper.description: Deploy the GmfDumper UE4SS mod and merge its settings keys. Needs a gameWrite authorization.

collect.description: Copy the newest complete GmfDumper run into dumps/unreal/runs/, and the object dump, usmap and header dump from the UE4SS folder into dumps/, then normalize the object dump.

operations.title: Extract Unreal assets
operations.summary: Copy cooked assets out of the game into the workspace as legacy .uasset/.uexp files: retoc to-legacy on IoStore games, repak unpack on pak games. Pass a filter; a whole game can be gigabytes.

filter.description: Asset file name filter, e.g. DT_LoadingScreenTips.

aesKey.description: 256-bit AES key for an encrypted game, as 0x-hex or base64. Also read from GMF_AES_KEY or the workspace gmf.local.json "aesKey". Never recorded.

operations.title: Inspect an Unreal asset
operations.summary: Convert an extracted asset to UAssetAPI JSON with UAssetGUI (engine version from the profile, .usmap from dumps/) and list its exports. Edit the JSON, then run unreal.stage_asset.

assetPath.description: An extracted .uasset/.umap, absolute or relative to extracted/unreal/legacy.

mountPath.description: The asset path inside the pak; required when the asset is outside extracted/unreal/legacy.

mappings.description: A .usmap file; default the newest under dumps/.

operations.title: Check Lua structure
operations.summary: Check block and bracket balance, module field references and, when lua-language-server is on PATH, its warnings. Nothing is installed.

operations.title: Normalize a UE4SS object dump
operations.summary: Build the normalized dump JSON the analyze operations read from UE4SS_ObjectDump.txt. Keeps object names, classes, paths and addresses only.

operations.title: Pack an Unreal asset mod
operations.summary: Pack mods/<mod>/pak/ into mods/<mod>/dist/<mod>_P: .pak, .utoc and .ucas with retoc to-zen on IoStore games, one .pak with repak otherwise. Deploy with unreal.deploy --input type=pak.

operations.title: Package an Unreal mod
operations.summary: Build a pak with repak when the project requests one, then package the mod folder into a local zip under dist/.

operations.title: Analyze a PE executable
operations.summary: Read the sections, imports, exports, timestamp and executable range of a 64-bit PE file without running it.

operations.title: Read text files from the game's paks
operations.summary: List each .pak in Content/Paks with repak and extract only the .ini, .locres, .uplugin and .uproject entries into extracted/unreal/text/<pak>/, for the docs builder. Paks in ~mods and LogicMods are skipped.

aesKey.description: 256-bit AES key for an encrypted game, as 0x-hex or base64. Also read from GMF_AES_KEY or the workspace gmf.local.json "aesKey". Never recorded.

operations.title: Remove a deployed UE4SS mod
operations.summary: Back up and remove a deployed mod: a UE4SS mod folder under ue4ss/Mods, or a pak mod's <name>_P files in Content/Paks/~mods or LogicMods. Needs a gameWrite authorization.

name.description: The UE4SS mod folder name, or the pak mod name (without _P).

operations.title: Start the game once and dump it with GmfDumper
operations.summary: Write Mods/GmfDumper/config.lua for an automatic run, remove the once-only marker, start the game (through Steam when the app id is known, otherwise the executable) and wait for the run. status is complete (the run is collected into dumps/unreal/runs/), empty (the mod produced nothing; manifestReasons says why), crashed (a new crash dump), exited (the game closed without finishing; logTail holds the log), or running (waitMinutes passed; call unreal.dump with collect=true later). It never stops the game. It refuses when the dumper is not deployed or the game is already running.

quitWhenDone.description: Close the game when the run has finished. Default true.

removeDumper.description: After a verified run, wait for the game to close and remove Mods/GmfDumper (backed up first); deploy it again for the next dump. Default true.

removeGameCopy.description: Remove the run from <ue4ss>/Dumps once its workspace copy passes unreal.verify_dump. Default true.

waitMinutes.description: How long to wait for the run before returning status running. Default 10.

operations.title: Scaffold an Unreal mod
operations.summary: Render a UE4SS Lua mod, a UE4SS C++ mod or a pak/Blueprint mod project into the workspace mods folder.

operations.title: Set up UE4SS
operations.summary: Install UE4SS from the tool registry into the game folder with a soft gate, record its version and verify the loader layout.

channel.description: Only experimental-latest, the release the catalog pins, can be installed. Default experimental-latest.

development.description: Apply the development settings profile (UE4SS debug console and GUI on and visible). Default true.

operations.title: Stage an edited Unreal asset in a mod
operations.summary: Convert edited UAssetAPI JSON back to a cooked asset with UAssetGUI, at the same mount path inside mods/<mod>/pak/, ready for unreal.pack_mod.

mod.description: The mod name; files go to mods/<mod>/pak/.

mountPath.description: Override the asset path inside the pak, e.g. Game/Content/Data/DT_X.uasset.

operations.title: Apply a UE4SS settings profile
operations.summary: Set the UE4SS debug console keys in UE4SS-settings.ini: the development profile turns ConsoleEnabled, GuiConsoleEnabled and GuiConsoleVisible on and sets GraphicsAPI = dx11, the release profile turns the console off. Backs up the ini first.

operations.title: Validate an Unreal mod
operations.summary: Check the Lua structure and require references, or confirm that a C++ DLL or pak file exists, and return log guidance.

operations.title: Verify a dump run against its manifest
operations.summary: Check a collected dump run: finished manifest, no failed steps, skipped steps explained, every listed file present with its recorded size, run_complete.json present, all levels dumped for the full profile. Prints PASS or one line per problem.

run.description: Run folder name under dumps/unreal/runs, or an absolute path. Default: the newest run by name.

operations.title: Run the plan's verification steps
operations.summary: Run every step's verify command that starts with gmf, record manual checks as such, and store the results under verification in the plan file.

plan.description: A plan object or path. Default: gmf.plan.json in the workspace.

operations.title: Initialize a workspace
operations.summary: Create the committed identity and machine path files for a game, and record the detected engine when one is identified.
